glossary.definition: (1) "Ancillary services" means services provided to an offender as necessary for the particular circumstances of the offender's personal supervision, including, but not limited to, specialized counseling, testing, or other services not included in the calculation of residential or supervision costs.
glossary.scope: (A) As used in sections 5120.56 to 5120.58 of the Revised Code:
glossary.source_title: Section 5120.56 - Recovering cost of incarceration or supervision from offender.

glossary.definition: (2) "Cost debt" means a cost of incarceration or supervision that may be assessed against and collected from an offender as a debt to the state as described in division (D) of this section.
glossary.scope: (A) As used in sections 5120.56 to 5120.58 of the Revised Code:
glossary.source_title: Section 5120.56 - Recovering cost of incarceration or supervision from offender.

glossary.definition: (3) "Detention facility" means any place used for the confinement of a person charged with or convicted of any crime.
